name: The Midnight Orchard
description: When the small town of Willow Creek awakens to a mysterious orchard that blooms only at midnight, its residents are drawn into a web of secrets and old magic. A young botanist named Elara must unravel the orchard's origins before the night fades. The novel blends lyrical prose with a touch of supernatural intrigue.
shortDescription: A haunting tale of a midnight-blooming orchard that reveals hidden secrets.
